titles.native: おくさまは天使 [ミカえる]?

description:
Here's the latest work of Yoshiten who has teamed up with Chichinoya as character designer and director! Mika and Shinichi are newly weds! Mika, initially hoping for a lot of romantic nights, is sad not being able to have sex with Shinichi, who is too busy. One day, she finds an apron, which is actually an alien called Frue! She ends up helping Frue, who can transform into various outfits, to chase down an evil alien who has escaped. Will Mika be able to protect the peace on Earth?! Will she be able to have sex with Shinichi again?! The first episode of an erotic transformation love comedy!

(Source: OceanVeil)
